scope: RAG-V2 secondary metric definitions, NATQ-001 validation n=40

A_MRR.canonical_formula: sum(1/rank for each gold span with a rank, 0 otherwise) / total_gold_spans
A_MRR.aggregation: micro-average over gold SPANS (not a per-case macro average)
A_MRR.code: round(sum((1 / s["rank"] for s in all_spans if s["rank"]), 0.0) / len(all_spans), 4)
A_MRR.divergence: EXP-023A computed a per-case macro average (mean over cases of the mean reciprocal rank of that case's spans), giving 0.3271 where the canonical span micro-average gives a different value. EXP-023A's MRR was NON-CANONICAL.
A_MRR.resolution: canonical = span micro-average; EXP-023A MRR is superseded by the addendum
A_MRR.chosen_by: provenance in shared harness code, not by which number is better

B_MULTI_SPAN.divergence: EXP-023A used len(expected_evidence) > 1 alone, giving 11 cases / 24 spans. The canonical union rule gives 12 / 25, matching all prior reporting.
B_MULTI_SPAN.note_for_coordinator: NATQ-C-170 carries the multi_span tag but has exactly one expected_evidence entry, evidence_shape short_contiguous, requires_all_evidence false. The canonical rule still admits it, and prior reporting counted it. Flagged as a frozen benchmark tagging inconsistency for the coordinator; NOT modified here.

C_EXACT_IDENTIFIER.authority: EVAL-NATQ-VAL-001-REPORT.md lines 54 and 62 report exact_identifier_lookup n=17 on this validation split; the union of coverage_tags and stress_types reproduces 17 exactly (coverage_tags alone 17, stress_types alone 15)
C_EXACT_IDENTIFIER.divergence: EXP-023A searched for the tag 'exact_identifier' — which does not exist in the frozen vocabulary — and therefore reported n=0. This was a tag-name error, not a definitional disagreement.
